sprint_goal: Release cut, filer, validate, refine and the carried units lose 25 Medium bugs; each fix's test fails without it

seats.achievable: partial - all 25 bugs in the batch are Medium (BG0948, BG0959, BG0967, BG0968, BG0995, BG0997, BG1417, BG1452, BG1475, BG1510, BG1532, BG1537, BG1541, BG1542, BG1544, BG1545, BG1549, BG1550, BG1551, BG1552, BG1567, BG1625, BG1707, BG1714, BG1717), so the count of 25 is reachable on paper, but the batch is 83 points (run twenty-two landed 66, run twenty-one 79), every shared-file cluster must run in sequence, and the three carried pairs (BG1625/BG1717, BG1475/BG1707, BG1532/BG1714) were each rejected at the round-2 cap, so a third rejection would leave the count short.
seats.done_means: Done means each of the 25 Medium bugs reaches Fixed and the four stories (US1324, US1326, US1190, US1191) reach Done, every criterion passing on its executable Verify line, with each fix's test seen red at HEAD before the fix; this serves O1 (shipped means verified) and O5, and Rowan Achterberg's end goals 1 to 3 (US1190, US1191, BG1545, BG1510, BG1542, BG1544).
seats.one_increment: no - the goal names release cut, filer, validate, refine and the carried units, but the batch also holds the engagement floor (BG0959, BG0997), CI workflow (BG0968, BG1417), public docs (BG1549, BG1550), the sprint plan advisory (US1326) and the gate-host commit suites (US1190, US1191). That is nine units (about 22 points) the goal sentence does not name; the Medium count is reached without them, so they read as an extra increment or the goal needs widening.
seats.note: 1) Manual Verify lines carry no test that fails without the fix: BG1717 AC1, AC5, AC6 (AC5 names a case and a mutant in prose but verifies manually), BG1707 AC1 and BG1714 AC1, AC6 (a comment over-claim). Give each a pytest or mark it a documentation criterion; AC5 of BG1717 and AC1 of BG1707 are real code defects and need executable pins. 2) BG1717, BG1707, BG1714 restate their parent's still-passing criteria and share Affects with BG1625, BG1475, BG1532: each pair is two reviews of one diff, and the parent's changelog fragment (changelog.d/BG1625.md and the like) is in both Affects, so close the pair together. 3) US1191 AC1 calls remote-gate's staged-tree mode from US1190 but neither story declares Depends on; US1190 must land first, and US1191 edits .githooks/commit-msg, which then changes every later commit in the run (stage it last, as the batch's gate-risk unit). 4) BG0959 carries a Notes warning that sdlc-studio/prd.md must be added to its Affects (tools/tests/test_lean_prd_refresh.py reads its status) and it is not in the Affects on disk, so the Fixed transition will turn that test red. 5) BG0967 has one criterion with a -k selector over a not-yet-existing file, and 2 points for a safing fix its triage says should be done together with BG0974 (not in the batch); check the selector collects. 6) US1326's AC1 and AC5 fixtures need a real git repo with a worktree; with 3 points that is tight against six criteria. 7) BG1532's Affects span seven scripts plus trd.md; if its fix round touches them again it re-enters the lane-3 serial chain of six units on file_finding.py and artifact.py.

clauses.Release cut, filer, validate, refine and: partial - the 25 Medium bugs are present: release cut by BG1510, BG1542, BG1544, BG1545; filer by BG0967, BG1541, BG1567 (US1324 beside them); validate by BG0948, BG1537; refine and reconcile by BG0995, BG1452, BG1551, BG1552; carried by BG1625, BG1717, BG1475, BG1707, BG1532, BG1714. The remaining six Medium bugs (BG0959, BG0997, BG0968, BG1417, BG1549, BG1550) sit outside the named areas yet are needed to make 25. Missing: the clause does not name the engagement floor, CI and docs units, and the 83 points flag capacity as unfit.
clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - 22 of 29 units have only pytest Verify lines, each naming a test that does not yet exist or a Fails-on clause (BG1545, US1324, US1326, US1190, US1191 are strong: each criterion states what HEAD does wrong). Short on: BG1717 AC1, AC5, AC6, BG1707 AC1, BG1714 AC1, AC6 verify manually, so nothing proves their fix by a test that fails without it; BG0967, BG0995, BG1452 and BG1417 have one criterion each. The batch has no step that records the test red at HEAD, so the clause depends on the builders and reviewers running each test against the unfixed code (LC-001, LC-004).

seats.achievable: partial - the 25 Medium bugs are all in the batch (29 units = 25 Medium bugs plus US1324, US1326, US1190, US1191, which are stories), so the count can be met, but 83 points against run 22's 66 and a plan that says the batch does not fit makes finishing all 25 uncertain, and the three carried pairs (BG1625+BG1717, BG1475+BG1707, BG1532+BG1714) were each rejected at the round-2 cap once already.
seats.done_means: All 25 Medium bugs in the batch reach Fixed, each with a test shown red without its fix and green with it, so the release cut, filer, validate, refine and carried-unit defects stop reaching Maya Okafor and Rowan Achterberg; serves O1 and O4 (Maya End goals 1 and 4) and Rowan End goal 3 (a release a consuming team can upgrade to).
seats.one_increment: no - the release-cut, filer, validate, refine and carried lanes read as one 'close the Medium backlog' increment, but eleven of the units sit outside the five areas the goal names: BG0959, BG0997 (engagement floor), BG0968, BG1417 (CI lint), BG1549, BG1550 (public docs), US1326 (sprint plan advisory) and US1190, US1191 (gate host, CR0663). They share only the Medium count, not a theme.
seats.note: (1) US1190 (5 pts) and US1191 (3 pts) are Draft stories, not Mediums, and no clause of the goal needs them; they serve Rowan End goal 1 (push judged in about ten minutes), so name that or defer them to cut the capacity overrun. US1326 and US1324 are likewise stories outside the 25. (2) BG0959's own Notes say sdlc-studio/prd.md must be added to its Affects, because tools/tests/test_lean_prd_refresh.py::PrdRulesTests reads its status and goes red on Fixed otherwise; its Affects is only engagement_floor.py, its test and changelog.d/BG0959.md. That would block the commit. (3) BG0967's triage says to fix it with BG0974 (the opposite failure in the same safing), yet BG0974 is not in the batch. (4) BG1717, BG1707 and BG1714 are review-cap carries whose open findings are narrow (pytest -k=add, merge path from repo top, io.open scope over-claim) but carry their parent's whole Affects; the pairs are serial and the second of each risks re-rejection. (5) The goal names no PRD outcome or persona in its text; I read it as O1/O4 for Maya and Rowan EG3. (6) Six shared-file clusters force sequential delivery, so cost per point is the exposure.

clauses.each fix's test fails without it: partial - most bugs carry Fails on lines (BG1475, BG1707, BG1532, BG1714, BG1510, BG1542, BG1544, BG1545, BG1541, BG1567, BG1537, BG1551, BG1552 and the stories), so a red-without-the-fix test is stated. BG0967, BG0948, BG0995, BG0959, BG0997 and BG0968 have Verify lines but no Fails on, and BG0967 and BG0995 have a single -k selector each; nothing in the batch makes the author show the test red at the pre-fix commit. seats.achievable: partial - the 25 Medium bugs are all in the batch (29 units less US1324, US1326, US1190, US1191), so the count can be met, but only if the three carried pairs (BG1625/BG1717, BG1475/BG1707, BG1532/BG1714), which have each failed review at least twice, converge, and 83 points is above the 50 to 79 norm.
seats.done_means: All 25 Medium bugs read Fixed, each through a recorded independent review and a green verify_ac run of its criteria, and the four stories read Done; this serves O1 (shipped means verified) and O5 (a repeated failure fixed in the code path).
seats.one_increment: yes - mostly: release cut (BG1510 BG1542 BG1544 BG1545), filer (BG0967 BG1541 BG1567 US1324), validate (BG0948 BG1537), refine (BG0995 BG1452 BG1551 BG1552) and the carried pairs read as one 'harden the shipped tools' increment. EF (BG0959 BG0997), CI (BG0968 BG1417), DOC (BG1549 BG1550), PLAN (US1326) and the gate-host stories US1190 and US1191 are not named by the goal and are drift from it.
seats.note: (1) BG1717 AC1, AC5, AC6 and BG1707/BG1714 round findings use 'manual - the independent review re-checks' Verify lines, which no oracle can fail, so those acceptance criteria rest on the reviewer alone; only their carried-forward ACs (AC2-AC4) are executable. (2) BG0967, BG0948, BG0995, BG0959, BG0997 and BG0968 carry no 'Fails on' clause, so nothing states what broken code the test must catch. (3) BG1551 AC4, BG1552 AC4 and BG1549 AC2 are corpus edits with no Verify line (BG1549 has 1 Verify for 2 ACs), so verify_ac cannot go red on them. (4) BG0959's note requires sdlc-studio/prd.md in Affects (tools/tests/test_lean_prd_refresh.py reads this bug) but its Affects lacks it, so Fixed will turn that test red. (5) Planned test files and classes (test_engagement_floor CutoffTests, EpicPartialDeliveryTests, test_ci_suites_unchained.py) do not exist at HEAD, so failing-first is only proved if the builder records the red run before the fix. (6) Shared-file clusters (BG0967, BG1532, BG1541, BG1567, BG1714, US1324; BG0995, BG1452, BG1551, BG1552) force serial lanes. (7) US1190 and US1191 are Draft at 5 and 3 points with remote-gate dependence; not needed for the 25.
